title: Cube Consumption Cost Anomaly
app: Cube API query logs and Cube Store metrics via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=cube:api
| timechart span=1d sum(db_rows_scanned) as consumption by cube_name
| untable _time cube_name consumption
| eventstats avg(consumption) as avg_c, stdev(consumption) as sd_c by cube_name
| where consumption>avg_c+3*sd_c
| sort - consumption
description: Baselines daily Cube consumption per cube and flags spikes far above normal, the main early-warning signal for a runaway bill.
value: Cube cost is usage-driven and can spike overnight from a bad job or backfill; per-cube anomaly detection catches overruns within a day rather than at invoice time.
implementation: Ingest Cube consumption metrics; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma consumption spikes per cube.
visualization: Timechart of consumption per cube, anomaly table, cost projection.
grandmaExplanation: We watch what Cube costs to run each day so a surprise spike is caught before the bill arrives.
